en:
K-Kaede! And...Rantaro?
Kirumi? Ryoma?

I made them! Don't they look lifelike?
Aren't they just divine?
You made them...?

Yep, they're my very own handcrafted wax
effigies.
Wax effigies? Why?
Why? For the resurrection ritual, of course.

Umm, according to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Necronomicon<CLT=cltNORMAL>, we need
an effigy of the deceased to perform the <CLT=cltSTRONG>ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
So I went ahead and made these.

Simple dolls probably would've been better, but
once I got to work, Atua took possession of me.

Nyahaha! And before I knew it, I had made these!
What do you think? Aren't they amazing?
You do such cruel things so innocently.
Hm? What?

It's incredible...
For a second, I thought they were real.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah...just like the real thing.
But...

You try persuading her first. Detectives are
good at talking, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like she might have some
misconceptions about detectives...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I know Maki isn't very good at
persuading people. So it's up to me.

The fact that Angie can do things like this
without a care is what makes her so dangerous.
Please! You have to stop Angie!
Angie...could you please reconsider?
...I see, I see. Reconsider what, exactly?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL> that you're
trying to do.

I don't think you understand how
bad that might be.

Remember that this was Monokuma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
If he *wants* us to do it, it can't be good.

But the dead can't really come back to life.
So the people who died must still be alive—
No, Angie. That's not possible.

The bodies were not fakes. I'm positive.
Especially after seeing the wax effigies.

The effigies were nearly perfect, but the real
bodies still had <CLT=cltSTRONG>traces of a soul<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>A soul<CLT=cltNORMAL> desperate to live,
struggling, fighting for life...
That's something that can never be replicated.

No matter what technology you have,
you can't fake a soul.
Ryoma, Kirumi, Rantaro...and Kaede...are dead.

...I agree. I have no doubts that their
<CLT=cltSTRONG>deaths were real<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Trust me, I've seen my fair share of dead
bodies.

I see, I see... If that's what Maki says then
maybe they really are dead.

Then...if we do the ritual, will we actually
resurrect the dead?
What a miraculous mystery.
Huh?

...What are you saying? Someone who has
died can't be resurrected.
Hm? But that's not what Atua says.

He says that if we do the ritual, everyone who
has died up till now will come back.

So...if those four really are dead, then the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL> will surely work.

Nyahahaha! That must be right!
Cuz Atua is never wrong!
You're...not gonna stop this, are you?
Of course not! This is Atua's will!
This is your will, not Atua's.
Nuh-uh, it's Atua's.

Atua told me that our friends will come back
to life if we do this ritual.

So we have to do it. We can't defy a direct
command from Atua.
Or else...we'll get punished, y'know?

You're probably still worried about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
Shuichi, but it's okay.

Atua has spoken... Nothing bad will happen as
long as you put aside all thoughts of escape.

Is that so? Then there's no point
talking anymore.

Hmm, are we done talking now? Cuz I'm
still busy preparing for the ritual.

If you're gonna slow me down, I'll turn you into
a wax effigy! Nyahahaha!

Tenko, let's go back for now.
I think we may need another plan...
O-Okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>After failing to persuade Angie,
we reluctantly left the lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>We have to find some way
to persuade her.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltMIND>Lump of wax

<CLT=cltMIND>We have to find some way
to persuade her.

<CLT=cltMIND>We have to find some way
to persuade her.
<CLT=cltMIND>It really looks like Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...actually—

<CLT=cltMIND>The more I look at it, the more it
looks like Rantaro...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...actually—
<CLT=cltMIND>It looks exactly like Kirumi...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...actually—

<CLT=cltMIND>...It looks exactly like Kaede.
The face and body, it looks like the real thing...
<CLT=cltMIND>But...actually—
